name: reboards
title: ReBoards
description: Revamped agile boards: work with relations, group subtasks under their parent, use multiple swimlane levels and plan in time.
changeNotes:
Version 1.4.0:
- Add a Gantt layout next to the time layout: planning levels from high-level to detailed, due dates, persons needed from the estimate, subtask trees and relation arrows; reschedule by dragging bars, edges and due dates, plan unscheduled issues by drawing on their row, and add missing planning levels with +.
- Support float fields.
